blockers.description: Grafana's legacy singlestat panel type does not render a value for 2 of the PostgreSQL Exporter dashboard's 13 stat/gauge panels (Max Connections, Shared Buffers), despite the datasource proxy returning the correct value. Every other structural difference against a working sibling panel (query shape, legendFormat, datasource field) has been eliminated as the cause.
blockers.workaround: Diagnosed and accepted as a cosmetic Grafana-version compatibility finding, not a data-correctness defect -- D-06's actual metrics collection and 11 other panels on the same dashboard are proven working. Record as an accepted finding in 12-04-SUMMARY.md rather than continuing to chase it; a proper fix would mean migrating these 2 panels from the deprecated `singlestat` type to the modern `stat` type's different JSON schema, which is more invasive than this plan's scope warrants.

decisions.decision: Picked cAdvisor dashboard ID 14282 ('Cadvisor exporter') over the alternative candidate 193 ('Docker monitoring')
decisions.rationale: 14282 is purpose-built for cAdvisor specifically (CPU/memory/network per container, matching D-05's scope exactly) with 148k downloads; 193 is a generic multi-tool dashboard.

decisions.decision: Fixed two real metric-name mismatches in the postgres-exporter dashboard (pg_replication_lag -> pg_replication_lag_seconds, pg_database_size -> pg_database_size_bytes) rather than accepting them as uncollected-metric gaps
decisions.rationale: Cross-checked every pg_*{...} query in the vendored dashboard against the live exporter's actual /metrics output; these were genuine renames the community dashboard predates, not genuinely absent metrics.

decisions.decision: Fixed the Instance template variable's job label (job="postgres-exporter" -> job="postgres")
decisions.rationale: This deployment's Prometheus job is named 'postgres' per 12-03's own scrape config; the vendored dashboard's default assumed a job named 'postgres-exporter'. Zero series matched, so $Instance resolved empty and cascaded into ~10 panels showing N/A/No data -- confirmed live via user screenshots before and after the fix.

decisions.decision: Fixed a CI workflow gap unrelated to this plan's own scope: .github/workflows/deploy.yml's Caddyfile validation step was missing -e APP_DOMAIN_MONITORING, introduced by 12-01's third Caddyfile site block but never wired into CI
decisions.rationale: Was silently failing build-and-push-caddy-image (and skipping deploy-to-netcup, production deploy) on every push since 12-01 merged. Verified locally against the exact CI command before committing (64626d7); confirmed the full pipeline went green afterward including a previously-blocked production deploy.
